exec: pm.test("Status is 200 and body is an array", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an("array"); });

exec: pm.test("availableCopies equals totalCopies", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.availableCopies).to.eql(b.totalCopies); });
pm.test("Starts as REQUESTED with no fine and no dates", function () { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("REQUESTED"); pm.expect(r.fineAmount).to.eql(0); pm.expect(r.dueDate).to.eql(null); });
pm.test("Keeps a snapshot of the title and author", function () { pm.expect(r.bookTitle).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; pm.expect(r.bookAuthor).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; });

pm.test("Contains the request just made", function () { const id = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("borrowId")); pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(function (r) { return r.id === id; })).to.eql(true); });

pm.test("Includes the new request, with the patron email and no password", function () { const id = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("borrowId")); const row = pm.response.json().find(function (r) { return r.id === id; }); pm.expect(row).to.be.an("object"); pm.expect(row.user.email).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(row.user).to.not.have.property("password"); });

item.name: Return it: a fineAmount sent by the client is ignored

exec: pm.test("RETURNED, with a return date", function () { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("RETURNED"); pm.expect(r.returnDate).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("The SERVER charged 5 days x 10 = 50, not the 0 the client sent", function () { pm.expect(r.fineAmount).to.eql(50); });
